legs.label: NFL TNF: Patriots to win at Bears
legs.why: Anchor: DK CHI -148/NE +124 no-vig 42.8% NE; Novig exchange (Dimers) CHI -147/NE +144 = 40.8%; Kalshi 41c. Blend ~41.5%. Line opened CHI -1.5, now -3 at 7 of 9 books (VegasInsider) after NE lost both starting guards: Ben Brown (knee) and Vera-Tucker (hamstring) OUT on Wednesday's final report; Matt Pryor and Walter Rouse (first career start) replace them, RT Moses Q, CB Carlton Davis OUT (plus CBs Prunty, Canada). Chain: interior pressure vs Maye on a short week; CHI's top-10 defense (EPA/play, success rate) gets the matchup. Offset: CHI LB Sanborn OUT, LB T.J. Edwards doubtful (thin middle vs NE backs/TEs), RB Monangai OUT. Both 4-2; NE won 3 straight; Caleb Williams 30/36, 305 yds in his return (CHI 90 pts in his 2 full starts). Short week both sides; weather n/a. News broke Wednesday and the line moved 1.5 pts, so it is priced. Moved -0.5 for the OL chain: 41%. Polymarket US ask ~40.5c (1 - Bears bid 59.5): +0.5c, no edge.

legs.why: Anchor: DK 49.5 (-110/-110) and Novig 50.5 (O -106/U +104, no-vig Under 49.5%): Under 50.5 ~50.5% blended. Dimers model Under 51.4% (projects 26-23 = 49). JMU 7-0, 42.9 ppg for / 16.0 against; RB Pettaway 767 yds, 4 straight 100-yd games vs App run D 101st in rush success allowed; App DL Benton and Harris OUT. JMU 3-8 all-time in Boone; won 58-10 last year. Total fell 57.5 -> 56.5 against 96% of money. Singleton news is a slight App plus, offsets the DL losses: 51%. Polymarket page JMU -10.5 at 49c: +2c, below bar. Volume $23.8K on the event.
